description: Hello #TeamCastro! We are doing the hard things. "Not because they are easy, but because they are hard." Canvassing in the Georgia late summer heat. Cold calling potential donors. Calling Republican voters. Being present in the community as much as humanly possible. Driving stakes into the ground for our signs, that even though they might get stolen, they still proclaim our positive campaign. Sacrificing our hard-earned dollars to support people in need in our community. Showing up every day to do the work. THANK YOU to all the #TeamCastro volunteers who work beside one another to get the job done for this campaign. We are 53 days away from the election, and every moment, every door knocked, every phone call and every dollar counts. Thank you for being on this journey with me! By building community, we will prevail! Darcy Castro Candidate for Georgia Senate District 37 (NOTE FOR OUR REGULAR WEDNESDAY NIGHT VOLUNTEERS: We are taking two weeks off because I have events I need to attend, but we will start phonebanking as a team on September 30th!)
title: News from Darcy Castro
